description: This PHP class defines a data model named PurgeEmployeeModel within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The class encapsulates an employee number that is meant to be serialized for API responses, representing a 'purged' employee entity.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeModel
classes.description: A model class representing the data structure for an employee purge operation, with a single property 'empNumber' indicating the employee's identifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an employee number.

parameters.name: empNumber
parameters.description: The employee number to be associated with this model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model to an associative array suitable for API responses.
